conclusion: All four targets (CreateFileA, fopen, fopen_s, _wfopen) are patched in 39 loaded modules of the real game, and the shim is proven live in-process: it captured a CreateFileA open of \\.\pipe\wine_plugplay. No asset open was observed in 22-35 s of game time, so HYPER DEMON's asset reads do not use any of these import slots. hyperdemon.exe imports only CreateFileA/ReadFile from KERNEL32 and fopen/fopen_s/_wfopen from the UCRT API set, so the remaining candidates are the kernelbase/NtCreateFile path (no import slot to patch) or the Steam API file layer. No in-game asset replacement has been achieved yet.
